title: Odile and the Hollow
author: Tamsin Thornbury
blurb: Casper Iversen, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
